what: Syntax trees have no arena: each FlatTree block is one global-allocator allocation (crates/syntax-tree/src/flat/block.rs Block::new, std::alloc), so tree reads walk base pages. Put tree blocks on huge pages: a slab or size-class arena over blaze_mem::Region::reserve_huge (or blaze_mem::chunks, 2 MiB huge chunks) that blocks are returned to when an edit replaces a tree. Audit: docs/v2/plan/lanes/hugepages/design.md.
